title: Projection and fibering in groups of bounded exponent
summary: We develop a projection and fibering method for sets of small combinatorial doubling in (not necessarily abelian) discrete groups. As an application, in the abelian case we prove that, if $A$ is finite, the ambient group has exponent $r$, and $|A+A|\leq K|A|$, then \[ |\langle A\rangle|\leq r^{(2+o(1))K}|A|. \] This answers a question of Ruzsa with an optimal leading coefficient, independent of Fox--Pham.
